title: Changing Fourier Granularity
statement: Let $V$ be a finite additive group and a vector space over $\mathbb F_2$. Suppose every dual Fourier coefficient of a real-valued function $f$ on $V$ is an integer multiple of $\delta$. If $q\in\mathbb Z$ and $\delta=q\varepsilon$, then every dual Fourier coefficient of $f$ is an integer multiple of $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a vector space over $\mathbb F_2$
$f:V\to\mathbb R$ has all dual Fourier coefficients integer multiples of $\delta$
